title: HEADLAMP WASHER SYSTEM-HOSES
summary: Headlamp washer system, all models: the washer nozzle assemblies at the headlamps and the washer hose routing from the engine compartment forward along the generator & front lamp wiring harness, held by clips, to the headlamp housings. Each nozzle assembly is held to the headlamp housing / bezel with a washer and nut (View A); the hose itself is detailed in UPC 12.

fastening.qty: 2 per nozzle assembly (one top, one bottom)
fastening.note: View A: the nozzle assembly [6] has a threaded stem at each end. The upper stem goes up through a hole in the top of the headlamp housing and takes washer [9] and nut [8] from above; the lower stem goes down through a hole in the bezel and takes washer [9] and nut [8] from below, where the washer hose connects.

notes: CLIPS (hose clipped along the GEN & FWD LAMP WIRING HARNESS)
